# QRButik

> QRButik is a Swedish B2B SaaS for sports clubs and tournaments: a QR-based kiosk system with Swish checkout for visitors. Plans, all prices including 25% Swedish VAT: Gratis, Event 295 SEK (7 days), and Säsong 1 495 SEK/year (about 125 SEK/month). Platform billing uses Stripe; customer payments use Swish deep links to the club's own number.

## Target audience

- **Buyer:** Sports club board, treasurer, or office (idrottsförening, cup)
- **Users:** Team leaders running kiosks; treasurer needing consolidated sales and CSV/SIE export
- **Not targeting:** Private individuals running flea markets

## Business model

- Gratis: 1 kiosk, unlimited products, Swish QR, today's stats, small QRButik branding. No card.
- Event: 295 SEK one-time. Multiple kiosks, no branding, sales report and Excel export for 7 days.
- Säsong: 1 495 SEK/year (about 125 SEK/month). Unlimited kiosks and events, multiple admins, accounting export while active.
- Tagline: Digital kiosk för hela föreningen

## Core pages

- [Homepage](https://www.qrbutik.se/): B2B value prop, Gratis / Event / Säsong pricing, demo CTA
- [Pricing](https://www.qrbutik.se/priser): Gratis, Event 295 SEK one-time, Säsong 1 495 SEK/year
- [Explore sports](https://www.qrbutik.se/utforska): Hub and sport pages for club kiosks
- [Contact / demo](https://www.qrbutik.se/kontakt): Book a demo or create a club
- [Create organization](https://www.qrbutik.se/skapa): Onboarding on Gratis, no card
- [Admin](https://www.qrbutik.se/admin): Magic-link login; org billing and kiosks

## Customer-facing (no login)

- [Shop menu](https://www.qrbutik.se/s/{shopSlug}): Public menu and Swish payment
- [Receipt](https://www.qrbutik.se/tack/{transactionId}): Digital receipt after payment

## Product capabilities (positioning)

- Multiple kiosks under one club license
- Central dashboard for treasurer and board
- CSV and SIE export files
- Organization roles: owner, treasurer, editor

## Documentation for agents

- Roadmap: /ROADMAP.md

## SEO note

Public sport pages live under `/utforska` and `/utforska/{sport}` for a fixed set of sports. Primary SEO surface: homepage, `/priser`, `/utforska` and `/kontakt`.
